ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed toward low-intensity (black) pixels with a ratio of approximately 95:5 dark to high-intensity (white/gray) pixels restricted to isolated spots and apical clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous black field across both lobes. Distinct, isolated high-intensity circular punctate spots (0.5-2.0% of surface area) are scattered semi-randomly across the ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 100 degrees and a depth ratio of 1:8 relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing boundary. Notable macro-level irregular indentation on the medial-left trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the distal trailing edges leading toward acutely pointed lobe tips (apexes).

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme left and right lobe tips; secondary scatter of approximately 18 isolated white punctate marks across the lobe centers.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, large semi-circular notch/indentation located on the trailing edge of the left lobe, indicating tissue loss or healed trauma.
